categories.buying_advice:
## How to choose a mattress

Start with **weight**: every size shows the maximum load per sleeper, so pick one rated above your weight. Then choose a **firmness**: extra firm (5) for people who like a solid, level surface, firm (4) for support with some cushioning, medium (3) for a balanced feel, and soft (1–2) for side sleepers who love plush comfort.

Not sure? Use the [buyer's guide](/buyers-guide), check the [mattress size guide](/mattress-sizes) or compare every size in the [mattress price guide](/mattress-prices).

faqs.answer: Most people with back pain do best on a firm mattress — orthopedic or semi-orthopedic. See our [orthopedic mattresses](/orthopedic-mattresses).

products.name: Vitafoam Galaxy Orthopedic Mattress
products.description:
Experience firm, dependable comfort with the Vitafoam Galaxy Orthopedic Mattress, designed for people who prefer a solid sleeping surface and reliable support throughout the night.

Crafted with high-density foam, it provides a firm and stable foundation that helps distribute body weight across the mattress. Its extra-firm feel makes it an excellent choice for sleepers who dislike soft, sinking mattresses and prefer a surface that feels supportive and level.

Finished with a quilted cover and neat tape-edged detailing, it combines practical durability with a clean, premium look that suits any bedroom — master bedroom, guest room or personal space.

## Who is this mattress best for?

- Adults who prefer an extra-firm mattress
- People who don't enjoy sinking into soft mattresses
- Anyone who wants a stable, supportive sleeping surface
- Shoppers looking for a dependable mattress for everyday use

**Please note:** this mattress has a very firm feel. If you prefer a softer or more cushioned sleep, consider the Vitafoam Galaxy Classic or the Vitafoam Sizzler Super Soft.

## Available sizes

Choose a size that suits your bed frame and bedroom. Available sizes and thickness options may vary.

products.materials: Sandwich foam: a softer top layer over a firm foam base
products.description:
Enjoy a more comfortable and refreshing night's sleep with the Vitafoam Galaxy Classic Mattress, designed for people who want the stability of a firm mattress with an added touch of comfort.

Its sandwich foam construction combines a softer top layer with a firm, supportive foam base. The result is a surface that gently cushions your body while keeping the firmness many people prefer.

Unlike mattresses that feel too hard or too soft, the Galaxy Classic offers a balanced sleep: gentle cushioning around the shoulders and hips, with the firm base giving dependable support across the mattress.

## Who is the Vitafoam Galaxy Classic best for?

- Adults who find extra-firm orthopedic mattresses too hard
- Sleepers who find very soft mattresses uncomfortable
- Anyone looking for a balance of cushioning and support
- Families furnishing bedrooms with a dependable everyday mattress

posts.title: Mattress sizes in Nigeria: which one fits your room?
posts.excerpt: 6ft x 3.5ft, 4.5ft, 6ft or 7ft? How Nigerian mattress sizes compare, and how to measure your bed frame first.
posts.body:
## The standard sizes

Nigerian mattresses are almost always 6ft long. What changes is the width: **3.5ft** (single), **4ft** and **4.5ft** (double), **5ft** (queen), **6ft** (king) and **7ft** (super king).

## Measure the frame, not the old mattress

Old mattresses sag and spread. Measure the inside of your bed frame, then pick the size that matches it.

## Thickness

Thickness runs from 4" to 12". Thicker mattresses carry more weight and last longer. If two adults share the bed, choose at least 8".

[Shop mattresses by size](/mattresses)

posts.title: The best mattress for back pain (and when to choose orthopedic)
posts.excerpt: Firm doesn't always mean better. How to choose between orthopedic, semi-orthopedic and memory foam for back pain.
posts.body:
## Support first, then comfort

Your spine should stay straight when you lie on your side and keep its natural curve on your back. That needs a firm core.

## Orthopedic or semi-orthopedic?

**Orthopedic** mattresses (firmness 5) suit people over 90kg and those who sleep on their back. **Semi-orthopedic** (firmness 4) adds a softer top layer, which side sleepers usually prefer.

## Our picks

The Vitafoam Galaxy Orthopedic Mattress, Mouka Regal Orthopedic and Winco Orthopedic are our best sellers for back pain.

[See orthopedic mattresses](/orthopedic-mattresses)

posts.title: How to make your mattress last 10 years
posts.excerpt: Rotate it, protect it, and never fold it. Simple habits that double a mattress's life.
posts.body:
## Rotate every three months

Turn the mattress head-to-foot so it wears evenly.

## Use a protector

Sweat and spills are what ruin foam. A protector or topper keeps the mattress clean.

## Don't stand or jump on it

Concentrated weight breaks down foam cells quickly.

posts.title: How to choose the right pillow (and the best pillow for how you sleep)
posts.excerpt: Side sleepers need height, back sleepers need support, stomach sleepers need almost nothing. Here's how to pick.
posts.body:
## Start with how you sleep

The right pillow keeps your head and neck in line with your spine. How high it needs to be depends on how you sleep.

## Side sleepers

You need the most height to fill the gap between your ear and shoulder. A firm [memory foam pillow](/memory-foam-pillows) is usually best.

## Back sleepers

A medium pillow that supports the curve of your neck. Memory foam or a fuller fibre pillow both work.

## Stomach sleepers

Choose a low, soft [fibre pillow](/fibre-pillows), or none at all, so your neck isn't bent back.

## When to replace a pillow

Fold it in half. If it doesn't spring back, it's time. Most fibre pillows last 1–2 years; memory foam lasts longer.

See every price in the [pillow price guide](/pillow-prices).

posts.title: How to choose a good mattress: a 5-step guide
posts.excerpt: Weight, sleeping position, firmness, size and budget — in that order.
posts.body:
## 1. Check the weight rating

Every size we sell shows its maximum load per sleeper. Choose one rated above your weight; if two people share the bed, check it for the heavier sleeper.

## 2. Match firmness to how you sleep

Back sleepers and heavier sleepers do best on firm (4) or extra firm (5). Side sleepers usually prefer medium (3) or soft (1–2).

## 3. Pick the type

Foam is quiet and good value. [Orthopedic](/orthopedic-mattresses) gives the firmest support. [Spring](/spring-mattresses) is bouncier and cooler. [Memory foam](/memory-foam-mattresses) moulds to your body.

## 4. Measure the bed frame

Measure the inside of the frame, not the old mattress. See the [mattress size guide](/mattress-sizes).

## 5. Set a budget, then compare

The [mattress price guide](/mattress-prices) lists every size and price so you can compare like for like.

Still unsure? Our [buyer's guide](/buyers-guide) matches you to a mattress in two questions.

posts.title: How to choose an orthopedic mattress
posts.excerpt: Firmness, weight rating, thickness and whether you need orthopedic or semi-orthopedic.
posts.body:
## Do you need orthopedic at all?

An orthopedic mattress is very firm and keeps your spine level. It suits back sleepers, heavier sleepers and many people with lower back pain. If extra firm feels too hard, a [semi-orthopedic mattress](/semi-orthopedic-mattresses) adds a softer top layer.

## Check the weight rating

Firmness only helps if the foam is rated for your weight. Each size shows its maximum load.

## Choose at least 8 inches

Thicker orthopedic mattresses hold their shape longer, especially for two sleepers.

## Lie on it first

Firmness is personal. Try the [orthopedic mattresses](/orthopedic-mattresses) at our Wuse 2 showroom before you buy.

This is general advice, not medical advice. If you have ongoing back pain, see a doctor or physiotherapist.

posts.title: Memory foam vs spring mattress: which should you buy?
posts.excerpt: How they feel, how hot they sleep, how long they last, and who each one suits.
posts.body:
## How they feel

Memory foam moulds to your body and you sink in slightly. Springs push back, so you sleep on top of the mattress with more bounce.

## Heat

Springs let air move through the mattress, so they sleep cooler — useful in Nigerian weather. Memory foam holds more heat, though cooling covers help.

## Couples

Memory foam and pocket springs both stop you feeling your partner move. Open-coil springs don't.

## Which to choose

Side sleepers and people with sore joints often prefer [memory foam](/memory-foam-mattresses). Hot sleepers and people who like bounce often prefer [spring mattresses](/spring-mattresses). [Pocket-spring hybrids](/luxury-mattresses) combine both.
